mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we are looking at 57 degree overcast skies near Harriet Park. The moon phase is a waxing crescent, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 47 degrees with rain predicted.

The city recently updated information regarding local polling locations, noting that residents should check their status before election day. Additionally, the city is continuing its work on the zoning and sign ordinance overhaul.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness or stop by ART House 360 and Hop Haus for their Thursday night activities. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Officers confirmed no injuries occurred, and they are currently investigating a potential collision with a sign.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The shop is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
